passages.text:
[opaque block] Google Vault - Meeting with Daniel Rogers, Disinfo Index
Meeting with Daniel Rogers, Disinfo Index
[contact omitted] Meral Karan Tuesday, September 13, 2022 at 9:30:21 AM Eastern Daylight Time
To: [contact omitted] Daniel Stolkowski
Cc: [contact omitted] Diana Parzik, [opaque block] Susan Abbott
Hi Daniel,
A number of months ago, you and Diana arranged a presentation with Daniel Rogers from the Disinformation Index.
Diana is away at the moment and I'm trying to find his email. Could you share that with me? I'd like to follow up as their
research on the economic motivations around disinformation are really interesting and I'd like to learn more.
Thanks for your help!
Meral
Meral Karan
Team Lead, Democratic Resilience and Innovation Team
Center for Democracy, Human Rights, and Governance
US Agency for International Development
